turns.text: First thing I noticed, both Sarah and David used what we call conversation starters really effectively.
turns.zh: 我首先注意到的是，Sarah 和 David 都非常有效地用了我们所说的「对话开场白」。

turns.text: Sarah opened with, "You must be David, the new guy," which is a great way to introduce yourself when you already know something about the person.
turns.zh: Sarah 一开口就说：「你一定是 David，新来的那位吧」，当你已经对对方有所了解时，这是个很棒的自我介绍方式。

turns.text: It's friendly but not too formal.
turns.zh: 这样很友好，但又不会太正式。
而 David 回应得特别自然，

turns.text: He added, "That's me." And then immediately showed interest by saying he was hoping to meet people from other departments.
turns.zh: 他补了一句「就是我」，然后马上表示兴趣，说他一直希望能认识其他部门的人。

turns.text: This is a classic intermediate skill, expanding your answers and keeping the conversation going.
turns.zh: 这是一个典型的中级技巧——把回答展开，让对话继续下去。
